services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Mohammad Mayyan
reviews.text: The mechanic, Mike, is one of the most honest mechanics I have dealt with. He deserves all the respect.

reviews.author: Jackson Reid
reviews.text: Mike has done a ton of work for me on a ton of vehicles. Always has a great price and gets it done quickly. 10/10 auto shop.

reviews.author: Michael Hayes
reviews.text: Mike Durham is an anomaly in car repair service. I don’t have the tools or time to take care of some of the mechanical issues that arise with my vehicle. I can trust Mike to do an incredible job repairing my vehicle without the fear of being overcharged. Mike is a trustworthy mechanic. I cannot think of higher praise. 5 stars!

reviews.author: Greg Scott
reviews.text: I've brought my Expedition to Mike a couple times and he's always done a good job making repairs for a reasonable price. Would definitely recommend though you may have to wait for an appointment as he's pretty well booked.

reviews.author: Jose Rangel
reviews.text: Mike is the best mechanic around the area! As a college student I sometimes have trouble with my budget and He gave me the opportunity to pay him every time I could pay him. He understands that everyone has problems in life and he tries to do what ever is best for you. Mike is a good person with values and ethics I totally recommend him.

reviews.author: Keith Phelan
reviews.text: Incredibly helpful and fast service. I have a very old Jeep (1989) and Mike went above and beyond in taking care of the specified problem as well as identifying another issue that needed to be fixed. I wish I knew about him years ago

reviews.author: Blake Nelson
reviews.text: Mike did work on both my Toyota's and had them ready the following day. Top notch service for a price that beat everyone within a 30 mile radius. Highly recommend, fast, friendly, reliable service!

reviews.author: Lori Ann Selch
reviews.text: Great mechanic, fair, fast and friendly! He is a very good, honest and fairly priced mechanic. I have no worries when Mike tells me something needs repair. Wouldn't go anywhere else. Just the best!

reviews.author: Seminolesfan93
reviews.text: I have known Mike for many years now and he is the only one i trust to work on my vehicles. He is upfront with you and honest, very reasonable rates. Stays very busy so that should tell you something!!

reviews.author: David Millspaugh
reviews.text: This dude is great he knows his stuff and he is reasonable about price. He is so busy with customers that he doesn't really need to charge a lot. It is just him and maybe one other guy. The only downside is it's about 3 weeks out before you can get appointment. That's how.busy he is

reviews.author: Nushrat Humaira
reviews.text: Mike is very helpful, you can reach him over the phone to ask for advice and he will try to help you as soon as possible. He charges reasonable price for repairs and even checked everything complimentary once.

reviews.author: Dani Brewer
reviews.text: My car was making strange noises so I brought it in. Mike took a few minutes to look it over and tighten stuff up before telling me I was good to go. He dropped everything he was doing to look at my car, and in the end he didn’t even ask for payment. He seems like an amazing, kind man!!!

reviews.author: Michael Rhoads
reviews.text: Mike pretty much has all of my auto repair business. I trust him and he works hard to get my vehicles in and out in a timely manner. I don't know that I've ever known another mechanic to be any better.

reviews.author: Amy Pilgrim
reviews.text: Mike is just a really good honest person. We've been going to him for years and he's always taken great care of us. I think everyone around here uses him and if they don't they should.

reviews.author: Vincent Bozik
reviews.text: Here's how I explained it to Mike: "I'm here to get my car serviced because you also maintain my girlfriend's car which has 310,000 miles on it and it still runs great." (I've also seen her service records and receipts, and the costs for the work were very reasonable).

reviews.author: Rachel Mullinix
reviews.text: Great service, honest, and good prices. My family and I have been going to Mike for years and never had a problem from his service. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Seth Proctor
reviews.text: I’m sure Mike’s an honest guy, so honest he will tell you he doesn’t ever want to see your car again because the work you needed done was more involved than he expected. Bring your own pb blaster and rust reformer this guy wouldn’t know about it.

reviews.author: K Cole
reviews.text: They took care of my daughter's car repair promptly and professionally. I was concerned being out of state but they were able to work her in and fixed it in one day. Thanks Mike!

reviews.author: Sayani Ghosh
reviews.text: I have been going to Mike Durham Auto for past two years. They have been really helpful every time and their prices are very reasonable.

reviews.author: Richard St James
reviews.text: Mike is the best mechanic around. Fair, great work, and treats customers like they should be treated.

reviews.author: Jenna Crowder
reviews.text: Asked before fixing things that were not the reason for visiting. Gotta love that effort to save customers a bit of money. Fast service, friendly but not overly talkative. Five stars

reviews.author: Jesse Andrew Williams
reviews.text: Mike is honest, fair, and does a great job. I've been going to him for years and recommend him to everybody.

reviews.author: Cheryl
reviews.text: Great service and repairs to my daughter's car fast. Fair prices. Only accepts cash or check but definitely reflected on prices.

reviews.author: Richard Milan
reviews.text: Great experience. Took car in to check rattle. He took it for a drive came back put it in the air and showed me what was wrong. I will go back with any other problems .
